input: Subscribe to an online course for public speaking

gold.taskTitle: Subscribe to an online public speaking course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and subscribe to an online course that will help them improve their public speaking skills.

questions.title: What is your current public speaking experience level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some experience, or wants to refine advanced skills.

questions.title: What specific speaking skill do you most want to improve?
questions.description: Identify the core focus area such as confidence, body language, storytelling, handling nerves, or structuring speeches.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or event you are preparing for?
questions.description: Determine if there is a time-sensitive goal such as a work presentation, wedding speech, or job interview driving this task.

questions.title: What is your budget for this course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a free course, is open to a one-time purchase, or prefers a subscription-based platform.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Establish the user's available time commitment to match them with a course of appropriate length and pace.

questions.title: Do you prefer live sessions or self-paced recorded lessons?
questions.description: Determine the preferred learning format to narrow down suitable platforms and course types.

questions.title: Which platforms have you already considered or ruled out?
questions.description: Find out if the user has looked at options like Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, or Toastmasters to avoid redundant suggestions.
